about.title: Get to Know Me
about.subtitle: More than just a developer - here's a little about the person behind the code.
about.description1: I'm Fahrul Nurdiansyah, a Web Developer who enjoys turning ideas into functional, modern, and user-friendly digital products. I started exploring web development in 2022 and have been continuously learning, experimenting, and building projects to grow my skills ever since.
about.description2: I enjoy solving problems, designing solutions, and building applications from the ground up. For me, coding is more than just writing code — it's about using technology to solve real problems and create better experiences for users.
about.description3: I believe growth comes from curiosity and the willingness to keep learning. That's why I'm always open to new technologies, feedback, and opportunities to collaborate. My goal is to keep growing as a developer while building products that create real value.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Things I've built and worked on.

baksoMasJoni.title: Bakso Mas Joni
baksoMasJoni.description: A web-based management system for handling inventory, sales, and financial records for a small food business.
baksoMasJoni.problem: The business relied on manual records, making it difficult to track inventory, sales, and financial data accurately.
baksoMasJoni.solution: Built a centralized web application to manage inventory, record sales, and organize financial data in one place.

tanyaArul.title: tanyaArul
tanyaArul.description: An AI-powered Q&A web application that uses Gemini to provide interactive answers through a simple and responsive interface.
tanyaArul.problem: Finding quick and relevant answers often requires switching between different sources and searching through large amounts of information.
tanyaArul.solution: Built an AI-powered Q&A application using Gemini to provide interactive answers through a simple conversational interface.

ruligamelist.title: RuliGameList
ruligamelist.description: A game discovery web application for exploring games and managing data through a modern frontend interface.
ruligamelist.problem: Game information can be difficult to browse and organize when presented through scattered or poorly structured interfaces.
ruligamelist.solution: Created a game discovery platform with structured game data, filtering, and a responsive interface for easier exploration.

voiceAssistant.title: Ruli - Voice Assistant
voiceAssistant.description: A Python-based voice assistant that handles voice commands, searches Wikipedia, opens websites, and plays music.
voiceAssistant.problem: Performing simple computer tasks repeatedly through manual interaction can be time-consuming.
voiceAssistant.solution: Developed a Python voice assistant that executes common tasks through voice commands, including web searches, opening websites, and playing music.

library.title: Library Web
library.description: A library management web application for managing book data, borrowing records, and returning activities.
library.problem: Managing book collections and borrowing records manually can make it difficult to track book availability and transaction history.
library.solution: Built a centralized web application to manage books, borrowing transactions, and return records more efficiently.

ruliLearningLaravel.title: RuliLearning
ruliLearningLaravel.description: A Laravel-based learning platform with free and premium courses, online payments through Midtrans, and automated email confirmations.
ruliLearningLaravel.problem: Managing online learning materials, premium content, and payment verification manually can create an inefficient learning experience.
ruliLearningLaravel.solution: Developed a Laravel-based LMS with course management, premium content, Midtrans payment integration, and automated email confirmations.

ruliKlinik.title: RuliKlinik
ruliKlinik.description: A clinic management web application for patient registration and administrative data management with secure record handling.
ruliKlinik.problem: Manual patient registration and record management can make it difficult for clinic staff to organize and maintain patient data.
ruliKlinik.solution: Built a web-based clinic management system to handle patient registration and administrative records with structured data management.

vetrack.title: VeTrack
vetrack.description: A fleet management web application for monitoring vehicles, managing services, and handling vehicle orders in one centralized system.
vetrack.problem: Managing vehicle fleets across different records can make monitoring vehicle conditions, services, and orders inefficient.
vetrack.solution: Developed a centralized fleet management application for monitoring vehicles, managing service records, and handling vehicle orders.

ruliConnect.title: RuliConnect
ruliConnect.description: A social platform designed for personal branding, content sharing, and real-time user interaction with a modern interface.
ruliConnect.problem: Users need a centralized platform to showcase their identity, share content, and interact with others in real time.
ruliConnect.solution: Created a social platform that combines personal branding, content sharing, and real-time interaction in one modern interface.

catatan.title: Catatan
catatan.description: A Flutter-based note-taking application that uses Firebase for data storage and Google Generative AI for its intelligent chat feature.
catatan.problem: Users need a practical way to create, manage, and find information in their notes, while also getting assistance when they need additional information.
catatan.solution: Built a note-taking application using Firebase for data storage and Google Generative AI as an intelligent chat assistant to help users interact with their notes more effectively.

fahrulMovies.title: FahrulMovies21
fahrulMovies.description: FahrulMovies21 is a simple React-based web application that displays movie information using Bootstrap to create an attractive and responsive user interface.
fahrulMovies.problem: As my first project, I wanted to understand how React is used to build web applications and how movie data can be displayed and managed within an interface.
fahrulMovies.solution: Built a simple movie catalog application using React and Bootstrap to learn the fundamentals of components, data rendering, and responsive web interfaces.

zanila.title: Zanila In Bloom
zanila.description: Zanila In Bloom is a modern e-commerce web application built with Next.js for a flower shop. The application simplifies bouquet ordering for customers while providing an Admin Dashboard to manage and process orders.
zanila.problem: Manual flower ordering processes can make it difficult for customers to place orders and can make order management less efficient for the shop owner.
zanila.solution: Built an e-commerce system that allows customers to place orders online, upload payment proofs, and provides an Admin Dashboard to verify payments and manage order statuses in one centralized system.

myCalculator.title: MyCalculator
myCalculator.description: MyCalculator is a simple text-based calculator built with Python for performing various basic mathematical operations through a command-line interface.
myCalculator.problem: Users need a simple way to perform basic mathematical calculations without relying on a complex calculator interface.
myCalculator.solution: Built a command-line calculator using Python that supports addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, exponentiation, and square root calculations.

jihanLaundry.title: Jihan Laundry
jihanLaundry.description: Jihan Laundry is a web-based laundry service website designed to help customers explore services, calculate estimated costs, track laundry status, and request pickup and delivery services.
jihanLaundry.problem: Customers often have difficulty finding laundry service information, estimating costs, and checking their laundry status without contacting or visiting the outlet directly.
jihanLaundry.solution: Built a laundry service website that centralizes service information, provides a cost estimation calculator, enables laundry status tracking, and offers pickup and delivery services for a more convenient customer experience.

locationHistoryTracker.title: Location History Tracker
locationHistoryTracker.description: Flutter Location History Tracker is a Flutter-based mobile application designed to automatically and manually record and store the user's location history. Location data is stored locally using SQLite, allowing the application to work without a backend.
locationHistoryTracker.problem: Users need a way to record and review their location history periodically without having to open the application every time, including when the device is offline.
locationHistoryTracker.solution: Built a Flutter application with automatic location tracking using Workmanager and manual GPS-based location recording. Location history is stored locally using SQLite, while Provider is used for reactive state management.

geminiAiChatFlutter.title: Gemini Chat AI
geminiAiChatFlutter.description: Gemini AI Chat App is a Flutter-based chatbot integrated with the Gemini API. It allows users to interact with AI through a simple and interactive chat interface.
geminiAiChatFlutter.problem: Users need an easy way to interact with AI through a mobile device in a practical conversational format.
geminiAiChatFlutter.solution: Built a Flutter chatbot integrated with the Gemini API, allowing users to send messages and receive AI responses directly through a two-way conversation.

ruliSiPenerjemah.title: Ruli Si Penerjemah
ruliSiPenerjemah.description: Ruli si Penerjemah is a simple web-based translation application that allows users to translate text into various languages through a lightweight and responsive interface.
ruliSiPenerjemah.problem: Users need a practical way to translate text into different languages without dealing with a complex interface.
ruliSiPenerjemah.solution: Built a translation application using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with multiple language options and instant translation results through a responsive interface.
